dropoff_1.speaker: VASILE
dropoff_1.text: Channel 4. You're on the street. / Two at the shutter, one walking the fence.

dropoff_3.speaker: VASILE
dropoff_3.text: Then use it. Volkov's inside with the book.

alarm_volkov.speaker: VOLKOV
alarm_volkov.text: Read it before you hand it over!

alarm_vasile.speaker: VASILE
alarm_vasile.text: Biribel, they spotted you! Alarm is active!

inside_quiet.speaker: VASILE
inside_quiet.text: Clean so far. Keep it that way.

civilian_kevlar.speaker: VASILE
civilian_kevlar.text: Where'd you get the plate? Keep it on.

civilian_intel.speaker: VASILE
civilian_intel.text: If that civilian was right, the code's already in your head.

civilian_none.speaker: VASILE
civilian_none.text: No local help. Search the desks.

gate_open.speaker: VASILE
gate_open.text: Gate is open. Signatures ahead, watch the corners.

safe_locked.speaker: VASILE
safe_locked.text: Safe is locked. Look for notes on desks for the code.

keypad_hint_1.speaker: VASILE
keypad_hint_1.text: The memos said something about a shipment number…

keypad_hint_2.speaker: BIRIBEL
keypad_hint_2.text: Shipment 7742. Only the last three digits.

notebook_leaf.speaker: BIRIBEL
notebook_leaf.text: Half of it's gone. Route twelve.

files_already.speaker: VASILE
files_already.text: …Some of this was already in our files.

breach_brace.speaker: VASILE
breach_brace.text: BRACE! They're breaching the bay doors!

breach_both_sides.speaker: VASILE
breach_both_sides.text: They're coming from both sides! Get to the truck NOW!

volkov_escaped.speaker: VASILE
volkov_escaped.text: Volkov escaped! Get that notebook and get out.

ciocan_entrance.speaker: CIOCAN
ciocan_entrance.text: The clerk's new friend? Let's see.

exfil_van.speaker: VASILE
exfil_van.text: Company on the east road. Move.

exfil_truck_not_clear.speaker: VASILE
exfil_truck_not_clear.text: Not yet. Clear the yard before you put your head under that dash.

hotwire_tutorial.speaker: VASILE
hotwire_tutorial.text: Open the panel. Red feeds yellow. Blue wakes green. Black bites white.
